pack_name: Undesia Original Voxel Wedding Invitation Asset Pack
license: Original assets generated for this project; free to modify and use in your project. No Minecraft assets included.

models.purpose: Blocky garden tree; pair with grass and path
Decorative flowering tree for wedding garden
Ground tile with simple grass blades

notes: OBJ files are low-poly cuboid meshes with per-face material assignments.
Keep the OBJ files and voxel_wedding_palette.mtl in the same models directory.
For production, convert OBJ assets to GLB with Blender to reduce draw calls and simplify loading.
Grass movement should be implemented in Three.js using vertex shader sway or instanced grass blades; the supplied grass_tile is a static starter prop.
Use original couple photos, event details, maps, music, and QRIS/payment details supplied by the invitation owner.
